description.value: The Snaw-Naw-As Store is a convenience store located within the territory of the Snaw-naw-as (Nanoose) First Nation, a Coast Salish community at Nanoose Bay on southeastern Vancouver Island. The First Nation's traditional lands straddle the eastern coastline between Nanaimo and Parksville, a stretch frequently cycled by touring cyclists on the Island. This store serves the local First Nation community and may offer a useful stop for cyclists passing through this rural coastal corridor.
